mapper.insert: INSERT INTO draft_ledger_entry ( owner_user_id, owner_family_id, source_type, source_ref, raw_input, parsed_payload_json, preview_payload_json, status, confidence, missing_fields_json, confirm_txn_id, confirm_order_id, ignore_reason, created_at, updated_at, confirmed_at, ignored_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerUserId}, #{ownerFamilyId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{rawInput}, #{parsedPayloadJson}, #{previewPayloadJson}, 'DRAFT', #{confidence}, #{missingFieldsJson}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NOW(), NOW(), NULL, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM draft_ledger_entry WHERE id = #{id} AND FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE draft_ledger_entry SET source_type = #{sourceType}, source_ref = #{sourceRef}, raw_input = #{rawInput}, parsed_payload_json = #{parsedPayloadJson}, confidence = #{confidence}, missing_fields_json = #{missingFieldsJson}, preview_payload_json = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE draft_ledger_entry SET preview_payload_json = #{previewPayloadJson}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE draft_ledger_entry SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirm_txn_id = #{confirmTxnId}, confirm_order_id = #{confirmOrderId}, confirmed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE draft_ledger_entry SET status = 'IGNORED', ignore_reason = #{ignoreReason}, ignored_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
